feature: outlier-detection wrappers inside ordinary Channel weighted_target

scope.completion: unary and sequential or duplex stream terminal paths

contracts: every wrapper owns independent counters, multiplier, ejection timestamp and evaluation deadline
only endpoints under the wrapper hierarchical path contribute to its statistics
ejection removes picker eligibility without closing the underlying transport
unary and streaming terminal outcomes feed the same wrapper-local detector
expiry restores picker eligibility without resetting unrelated child policy state

implementation.ownership: each slot owns one persistent detector state per recursive wrapper plus exact membership
implementation.isolation: nested matching wrappers record independently and sibling wrapper indexes remain disabled
implementation.reconciliation: retained logical slots transfer detector arrays while new slots receive zeroed arrays transactionally
implementation.completion: unary records immediately and streams transfer recording to the existing exactly-once completion observer
implementation.selection: ejected slots are excluded from aggregate READY state, PF, RR, least-request, ring-hash and WRR
implementation.scheduling: eligibility changes invalidate leaf-local WRR snapshots
implementation.timers: wrapper deadlines start at Channel initialization and participate in wait-for-ready progress
implementation.transport: ejection preserves the established HTTP2 connection and endpoint backoff state

native_cases: one duplex UNAVAILABLE and one unary failure meet requestVolume 2 for the failing slot
one healthy unary response remains isolated in the sibling detector
after the 20-ms evaluation interval, five consecutive RPCs use only the healthy slot
after the 200-ms ejection expires, the failing slot participates again
a deterministic nested configuration gives path a wrapper memberships 0 and 1 but not 2
sibling path b belongs only to wrapper index 2
recursive construction and per-slot membership allocation pass every induced allocation failure
ServiceConfig is destroyed immediately after Channel initialization

negative_boundary.hostname_targets: ordinary weighted-target remains limited to static resolved endpoints
